title: Auxiliary Power Unit Firewall Panel and Drain Mast Rework in the Aft Fuselage Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Rework of the auxiliary power unit firewall panel and the compartment drain mast, after fluid pooling on the panel lower edge produced repeated corrosion findings and two smoke in the cabin events on the ground.

sections.reason: Scheduled inspections of the auxiliary power unit compartment produced forty-three corrosion findings on the firewall panel lower edge between 2014 and 2017, all of them at the same three fastener positions. Investigation showed that the compartment drain path allowed a residue of oil and water to stand on the panel edge instead of leaving the aircraft, and that the seal at the panel to frame joint wicked it into the fastener holes. On two aircraft the standing residue reached the compartment heat source and produced smoke that entered the cabin through the aft galley area, both on the ground and both without injury.
sections.description: The firewall panel D4910114423015 is replaced by an item with a formed lower edge that sheds fluid outboard, and the panel to frame joint is resealed with a new seal at FIN 9606PB. The compartment drain mast is repositioned forty millimetres aft and its bore increased, so that the compartment drains under all attitudes on the ground. The cowl latch D4910112220209 is retained but its anchor nuts AGS522879K5 are replaced because the new panel edge is thicker at the joint. The clamp D4910115671824 that supports the drain line is moved to the new mast position. The heat shield at FIN 633PB is inspected and refitted, and the nozzle at FIN 2PB is unaffected. Work is in zones 391, 394 and 396 with the compartment doors open. Detail is on drawing D49101112590.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 1.7 kilograms at the extreme aft of the aircraft, with a centre of gravity shift of 0.04 per cent MAC that is inside the loading envelope allowance. No electrical load change. Not interchangeable, because the frame land is re-drilled at embodiment. The corrosion inspection of the panel lower edge moves from a repeat item to a general visual, and the compartment drain check is added to the daily. The auxiliary power unit installation tasks, the parts figure and the flight crew description of the compartment fire protection all require re-issue.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN Z07601 in August 2018. Retrofit is by service bulletin during a base maintenance visit with the tail cone open; two shifts are quoted, of which most is sealant cure time. Kits include the panel, the mast, the seal and the anchor nut set.

type_data.balance_impact: Extreme aft installation, CG shift 0.04 % MAC
type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN Z07601, tail cone assembly jig adjusted over one weekend
